Charter pin S1 in memory/stack/stack.md still has `Guard: bash scripts/guards/no-prescribe.sh`, which now points at a deleted file. It is outside T3's scope and nothing executes it any more. pin-valid only checks the Guard field is present, so I left it.
Verification could not run in this environment (python3 and bash test commands needed approval). E4 and tests/check_92_stack.sh are untested; the build script's run should confirm them.

The check reads the file list from `git ls-files`, so it sees staged and unstaged edits to tracked files but skips untracked files. The check lives in `tests/stale_names.py` because the frozen tests import `stale_names.stale_hits`. `test_harness.py` only calls it.
The pattern ignores a name that sits inside a longer word or a hyphenated name. For example, `/tasks` inside `/tasks-foo` and `distill` inside `distillery` are not hits.
